article.title: Genitivo singular femenino de sustantivos en -а

claims.summary: Cornell lists -ы for feminine a-declension genitive singular and states the spelling replacement -ы to -и after specified consonants.
The source directly gives школа → школы and книга → книги as examples of the stated ending and spelling rule.
Нѐт большой школы and книга → книги are reproduced from Cornell’s genitive and spelling examples.
The page confines this entry to feminine a-declension forms and their cited spelling alternation.
